basis: Partial lens opacification defines an immature cataract.
Multinodular goiter, cystic renal dysplasia and digital skeletal anomalies define the syndrome; each is reported in 30-79%.
Benign cartilage-producing neoplasm arising beneath the periosteum on the bone surface.
Inherited interstitial lung disease with parenchymal abnormalities and impaired pulmonary function.
LRRK2-related Parkinson disease causes nigrostriatal neurodegeneration; motor manifestations do not establish primary muscle disease.
Autonomous adrenal cortisol excess; chronic cortisol-induced proximal myopathy affects roughly 50-80%. Separately diagnosed hypertension and diabetes excluded.
Congenital skeletal myopathy; ophthalmoplegia impairs ocular motility in 4/11 (~36%). Motor delay reflects muscle weakness.
Facial nerve synkinesis causes involuntary eyelid closure with jaw movement; cranial nerve and eyelid dysfunction define the syndrome.
Primary carcinoma of the peritoneal lining, classified with abdominal gastrointestinal serosa; ovarian resemblance does not establish ovarian origin.
Microcephaly, intellectual disability and sensorineural hearing loss define the syndrome. Facial dysmorphism alone does not establish other organ damage.
Adenoid/acantholytic squamous carcinoma is predominantly cutaneous. Definition specifies morphology without a site; pharyngeal synonym alone is insufficient.
Carcinoma originates in intrahepatic or extrahepatic bile ducts, both covered by the hepatic axis.
Brain degeneration, cataracts/microphthalmia and contractures define COFS. Hearing loss occurs in 30-79%; hypogonadism (30-79%) omitted at cap.
DNAJC21-related disease causes inherited marrow failure and immunodeficiency. Pancreatic and skeletal involvement vary; a >=30% frequency is not established here.
Clear-cell morphologic variant of basal cell carcinoma arising in skin.
Polyp occupies the frontal sinus; paranasal sinuses belong to the pulmonary axis.
Alphavirus infection umbrella includes arthritic and encephalitic diseases; persistent joint or brain damage is not established across the group.
Congenital cortical malformation; persistent flexion contractures and distal arthrogryposis are reported in 30-79%, supporting musculoskeletal involvement.
Lentigines, cardiac abnormalities and deafness are defining features. Intellectual disability/seizures occur in 1/1 assessed; evidence comes from a tiny series.
PRKAG2 cardiomyopathy is a cardiac glycogen-storage disorder causing hypertrophy, preexcitation and conduction abnormalities.
Noninvasive neoplasia of breast terminal ductal lobular units; breast has no axis. Subsequent invasive cancer is a separate disease risk.
Escherichia coli directly infects and inflames an intervertebral disc.
Sarcoma originates in uterine endometrial stroma, a reproductive site outside the axes; sarcoma histology alone does not imply locomotor involvement.
Congenital pituitary hypoplasia with growth hormone deficiency. Delayed bone maturation and microcephaly alone do not establish additional organ damage.
BCOR-altered childhood sarcomas typically arise in bone or soft tissue; the supplied concept does not specify a narrower anatomical site.
